recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-12306 is satisfied by the current source and later glossary work; additional changes would be separate glossary maintenance rather than a remaining fix for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-12306 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core documentation issue for the DSTU2-era help page. It reported incomplete content and links that did not point anywhere, with resolution text to locate and fix the page and Jira comments saying Grahame completed it.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-12306 was found. Source history shows Grahame's 2017 source/help.html change c24d6d9cc6 removed the old "Documentation Assistance And Glossary" placeholder list with broken same-page targets and replaced it with a simpler Glossary placeholder, matching the Jira comment timing.
additional_context: The help page remained the intended home for the FHIR glossary. Published issue FHIR-24866 later resolved to place the FHIR Glossary draft on build.fhir.org/help.html, and 2022 source commits inserted and formatted that content. The current build scope includes help.html in publish.ini; documentation.html links it as Glossary; and hierarchy.xml includes it in the documentation hierarchy.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source/help.html is now a 1698-line glossary with 324 term/heading matches, no remaining "not yet created" or volunteer placeholder text, and only valid local links to versions.html plus the external FHIR-I work-group page. No source edit is needed for the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue that formally placed the FHIR Glossary draft on help.html, completing the content side of the old placeholder.
